bernhar_10.m: Oh - a wandering kid! How surprising!

bernhar_12.m: My name is Bernhar. I am an explorer, and I'm trying to find out something about the cave system here.
r: Ah. Interesting. Keep having fun with it. Bye.

bernhar_16.m: Oh - the wandering kid! You are still alive? How surprising!
r: Hi Bernhar. I want to talk with you again.

bernhar_20.m: Sure! I could tell you things...

bernhar_30.m: Steep mountain flanks and wide, branching, cave passages! But beware - it is dangerous ground! You must not go unprotected!

bernhar_32.m: You are not taking me seriously. Let me tell you...

bernhar_40.m: You are risking your life here. It is not only those Arulir brutes. They are just annoying.

bernhar_50.m: The ground is really dangerous. It's deceptive and life-threatening. And there is always the danger of falling rocks from above.

bernhar_60.m: I was only able to survive this far because I was wearing the proper protective gear.

bernhar_70.m: I have completed my work here though, so I don't need it any more. I could sell it to you for a good price.

bernhar_80.m: If you go in there unprotected, I fear there will be no other time.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
